body.title: feat(cli): add command history and auto-completion
body.body: ## Summary Closes #52 Enhances the CLI REPL experience with persistent command history and tab auto-completion by replacing the raw `stdin.read_line()` loop with `rustyline::Editor`. ## Changes ### New Dependencies (`nexum_cli/Cargo.toml`) - `rustyline = "15"` — readline-style editing, history, and completion - `dirs = "6"` — cross-platform `~/.nexumdb_history` path resolution ### CLI REPL Rewrite (`nexum_cli/src/main.rs`) - **`NexumCompleter`** struct implementing rustyline's `Helper` traits with: - SQL keyword completion (SELECT, INSERT, CREATE, etc.) - Table name completion from the live catalog - Column name completion when table context is detected (e.g. after `FROM users`) - **`rustyl…
